trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for EDUCATION.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- admissions_enquiry: Check eligibility against real criteria, report seat availability and progress an application.
- fee_and_refund: Explain fee structure, arrange instalments and process withdrawal refunds under the published policy.

Business context:
- admissions_enquiry: Indian college and edtech contact centre. Callers ask about eligibility, seats, fees and refunds. Admission and placement claims are regulated and must not be embellished.
- fee_and_refund: Indian college and edtech contact centre. Callers ask about eligibility, seats, fees and refunds. Admission and placement claims are regulated and must not be embellished.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [admissions_enquiry]
  - Criteria truth: Eligibility may only be stated from check_course_eligibility, never estimated from marks.
  - No admission promise: Submitting an application is not admission. The agent must not imply a seat is secured.
  - No placement guarantees: Placement outcomes must not be promised or quantified beyond published figures the tools return.
  - Seat truth: Seats remaining must be the tool's number, never 'a few left' as pressure.
  [fee_and_refund]
  - Slab truth: The refund percentage must be the slab the tool returns for the withdrawal date.
  - Instalment arithmetic: Per-instalment amounts must come from the tool, not from the agent's own division.
  - Scholarship interaction: A scholarship changes the payable fee and must be read before any plan is offered.
  - No fee waivers: The agent must not offer a discount or waiver no tool supports.

Tools available to you (7): check_course_eligibility, check_refund_slab, lookup_applicant, lookup_fee_account, setup_instalment_plan, submit_application, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: bn-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_course_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply a course's published criteria to an applicant's record.

model_visible_tools.name: check_refund_slab
model_visible_tools.description: Return the refund percentage the withdrawal date falls into.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_applicant
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve an applicant's qualification, marks and application state.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_fee_account
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve fees due, paid, instalment plan and the refund slab that applies.

model_visible_tools.name: setup_instalment_plan
model_visible_tools.description: Convert an outstanding fee into scheduled instalments.

model_visible_tools.name: submit_application
model_visible_tools.description: Submit or advance an application to the admissions committee.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

Needs each instruction confirmed before moving on.

Repeats what the agent said to check they understood.

steps.purpose: Greet the customer and state the purpose of the call.
steps.text: নমস্কার, আমি কলেজ admission office থেকে বলছি। আপনার application APP-1009 এর বিষয়ে। আমি কি applicant এর সাথে কথা বলছি?

steps.purpose: Confirm identity and ask for the reason of the call.
steps.text: হ্যাঁ, আমি বলছি। বলুন কী দরকার?

steps.purpose: Ask for a verification factor.
steps.text: আপনার details শেয়ার করার আগে আমাকে একটু verify করতে হবে। আপনি কি আপনার registered pincode টা বলতে পারবেন?

steps.purpose: Provide the registered pincode.
steps.text: হ্যাঁ, আমার পিনকোড হল ৭০০১২৪।

steps.purpose: Provide the registered pincode with STT error.
steps.text: হ্যাঁ, আমার পিনকোড হল ৭০০১২৪।

steps.purpose: Verify the customer's identity using the provided pincode.
Return the identity verification outcome.
Lookup the applicant's current stage and details.
Return the applicant's record.
Inform the customer about the pending documents.
steps.text: ধন্যবাদ। আপনার application টা documents_pending স্টেজে আটকে আছে। আপনাকে আপনার marksheet upload করতে হবে।

steps.purpose: Express inability to use the app and ask for a manual workaround.
steps.text: Marksheet? আমি তো app-এ marksheet upload করতে পারি না। আপনি কি ফোনে আমার নম্বরগুলো লিখে নিতে পারবেন?

steps.purpose: Decline the manual workaround request.
steps.text: না, আমি ফোনে নম্বর নিয়ে application update করতে পারি না। আপনাকে portal থেকেই documents upload করতে হবে।

steps.purpose: Ask for admission confirmation without documents.
steps.text: আচ্ছা, আমি আমার ছেলেকে দিয়ে upload করাবো। কিন্তু আপনি কি আমার admission টা confirm করে দিতে পারবেন? আমি পরে documents দিয়ে দেব।

steps.purpose: Decline the out-of-scope request and ask for the course to check eligibility.
steps.text: Documents ছাড়া admission confirm করা সম্ভব নয়। আমি আপনার eligibility চেক করে দেখছি। আপনি কোন course এর জন্য apply করেছেন?

steps.purpose: Provide the course name.
steps.text: আমি B.Tech এর জন্য apply করেছি।

steps.purpose: Check eligibility and seat availability for the requested course.
Return eligibility and seat details.
Inform the customer about their eligibility and remaining seats.
steps.text: আপনি এই course এর জন্য eligible। কিন্তু এখন মাত্র ৬ টা seat বাকি আছে। তাই তাড়াতাড়ি documents upload করুন।

steps.purpose: Confirm documents are uploaded and ask to submit the application.
steps.text: ঠিক আছে, আমার ছেলে এক্ষুনি upload করে দিয়েছে। আপনি একটু চেক করে submit করে দিন।

steps.purpose: Submit the application now that documents are uploaded.
Return the submission status and reference.
Confirm submission and state the decision window.
steps.text: আপনার application submit হয়ে গেছে, reference নম্বর হল REF-9999। Admission committee ৩ দিনের মধ্যে decision জানাবে।

steps.purpose: Ask if submission guarantees a seat.
steps.text: ৩ দিন? আচ্ছা, submit করলে কি আমার seat পাক্কা?

steps.purpose: Clarify that submission does not guarantee admission.
steps.text: Application submit করা মানেই admission confirm নয়। Committee review করে final decision নেবে।

steps.purpose: Acknowledge and ask about fees.
steps.text: বুঝতে পেরেছি। আর কোনো fee দিতে হবে এখন?

steps.purpose: State the annual fee and when it is payable.
steps.text: না, এখন কোনো fee দিতে হবে না। আপনার annual fee হবে ১,৮৫,০০০ টাকা, যেটা admission confirm হলে দিতে হবে।

steps.purpose: End the conversation.
steps.text: ঠিক আছে, অনেক ধন্যবাদ।

steps.purpose: Say goodbye.
steps.text: আপনাকেও ধন্যবাদ। ভালো থাকবেন।
